body:
Adds the first reconstructed standing resident beside the Wolf Point wagons using the repaired Bardwell & Otis portable model. Connected waistcoat shoulders, grounded shoes and identity cards distinguish reconstructed appearance and placement from the historically modelled firm.

Canonical authoring/export remains source `96c4da4b` and successful run `39736567239`. All eight Bardwell raw/web GLBs, placement, person data and human runtime remain unchanged. This is an initial visible standing example; photographic appearance, complete tailoring, other people/eras, walking, drivers and riders remain open under T-1789.

Validation:

- Pushed source `248ecfb56c55c158e8062ce59cdc46a8f5ace624` passed full preflight: 1,048 checks including 381 self-tests, actual committed-HEAD checks and postcommit publication/mirror parity.
- The immutable fe98 full published batch is still being collected. Its original exact walk/1904 census and obsolete Home-tooltip failures remain failures. Source-proven repairs preserve exact set/count comparisons and all glossary/meaning/viewport/dismiss assertions; four fresh desktop/mobile 1–2 and 9–12 cells now run on immutable 248.
- DEV advanced with Kimball/First Presbyterian/context changes while that preflight ran. The existing scoped integration workflow is queued for only PR #1175, with the root lease deliberately released so it can push. Final integration normal CI, fresh published 14/15 both viewports and focused original What's-new/QA-11 checks remain pending.
- Earlier person desktop/mobile views and all eight reviewed images retain their original source labels and documented supplemental timing failures; they are not current combined-town results.

DEV only. No photographic-completion or broad parent-ticket closure. Recoverable source, exact failures, current claims and handover are periodically pushed to `kevinrhaas/chicago-tickets`.
